notes.title: The game version 1.1
notes.content:
Problem with the car keys is fixed, scene with the crying hippopotamus is fixed.

Anyone who still has a problem with the save file, in the scene with the hippopotamus, can send a private message to our steam account. The problem will be solved.
Thank you for your patience. 

Instructions on how to send a private message:
1. Click on the button: [url=https://s.team/p/grwb-nnhr/FGBDPRRG]Add Friend[/url]

2. On the new page click the button "Add As Friend"
3. On the new page click on the button "dragonseyelimited"
4. On the new page click the button "Message" and you will be able to send chat message to us in a new window!
